Summary: Final go-live discipline checklist for deployment readiness and operational ownership.
EntryCriteria: A release is approaching a production decision point.
ExitCriteria: Decision-makers have explicit evidence on quality, security, rollback, monitoring, support, and communication readiness.
Checks: Release scope and version identity are explicit.
Open conditions and residual risks are documented.
Rollback trigger and rollback owner are defined.
Monitoring and first-hour watch coverage are scheduled.
Support, customer, or stakeholder communication plans are ready if needed.
A named release decision owner has reviewed the evidence set.
EvidenceExpectations: Watch roster or equivalent operational note.
